easy.q: How many eyes does Mike Wazowski have in Pixar's Monsters, Inc.?
easy.fact: Billy Crystal voices Mike in Monsters, Inc. and Monsters University.

easy.q: How many Grand Slam tournaments are played in pro tennis each year?
easy.fact: They are the Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon and the U.S. Open.

easy.q: How many digits are in a basic U.S. ZIP code?
easy.fact: The extra four digits of ZIP+4 arrived in 1983.

easy.q: How many Brothers Grimm collected the famous fairy tales?
easy.fact: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm first published their tales in 1812.

easy.q: In the classic fairy tale, how many bears come home to find Goldilocks?
easy.fact: In the earliest known version, from 1831, the intruder was an old woman.

medium.q: In what year did Hannah Montana, starring Miley Cyrus, premiere on Disney Channel?
medium.fact: It ran for four seasons and spawned a 2009 movie.

medium.q: How many inches across is a regulation NHL hockey puck?
medium.fact: Pucks are frozen before games so they bounce less on the ice.

medium.q: How tall is Chicago's Cloud Gate sculpture, better known as "The Bean," in feet?
medium.fact: Its 168 stainless steel plates are welded so the seams can't be seen.

medium.q: How many beaches did Allied troops land on in Normandy on D-Day, June 6, 1944?
medium.fact: Their code names were Utah, Omaha, Gold, Juno and Sword.

medium.q: How many Die Hard movies has Bruce Willis starred in?
medium.fact: The first Die Hard came out in 1988; the fifth, A Good Day to Die Hard, in 2013.

hard.q: How many days were American hostages held in Iran during the 1979-81 hostage crisis?
hard.fact: The hostages were released minutes after Ronald Reagan was sworn in.

hard.q: How tall is San Francisco's Transamerica Pyramid, in feet?
hard.fact: It was the city's tallest building from 1972 until Salesforce Tower passed it in 2018.

hard.q: How many rushing yards did Barry Sanders gain in his 1997 MVP season?
hard.fact: He ran for at least 100 yards in 14 straight games that year.

hard.q: How many weeks did Morgan Wallen's Last Night spend at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100?
hard.fact: It was the longest-running No. 1 of 2023.
